title: How is your enterprise tracking AI agent telemetry? Groundcover thinks it should never leave your cloud
summary: Customers keep the data plane—including telemetry storage and processing— inside their own AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud environments, while groundcover provides a managed control plane and user experience. Instead, pricing is based primarily on monitored hosts, regardless of telemetry volume.
